name: Deal Tombstones
summary: Deal credentials grid: one tombstone card per transaction with deal type, parties in pitchbook wording, monogram tiles, value, date and role; sector / region chips cross-filter.
summary_zh: 交易业绩（tombstone）网格：每笔交易一张卡片，展示交易类型、按投行措辞排列的交易双方、首字母标识、交易金额、日期与本行角色；行业 / 地区筛选片可交叉筛选。
description_zh: 投行 pitchbook 的“credentials / tombstones”页：每行数据是一笔交易，卡片顶部为交易类型，中间按交易类型自动生成措辞（卖方并购“X has been acquired by Y”、买方并购“Y has acquired X”、收购融资、合并、IPO 等），下方为交易金额、公告日期和本行角色；标识用双方名称首字母生成的方块代替外部 logo，离线可用。卡片在响应式网格中等高排列（columns 控制每行最多卡片数，窄屏自动换行），highlight 指定的公司（如目标公司或本行客户）用强调色 accent2 标出。顶部的行业 / 地区筛选片会对报告中所有含 sector / region 字段的数据集做交叉筛选，未选中的卡片变淡；全局筛选变化时卡片平滑重排。适合 4–16 笔精选交易的业绩展示页。
best_for: Relevant experience in a sector or region
Deal team or adviser track record in a pitch
avoid_when: More than ~16 deals (use data-grid or a precedents table)
When deal multiples must be compared (use comps-table / scatter)

date.desc: Announcement / closing date (sort key, shown as 'August 2026')

acquirer.desc: Acquirer / borrower / merger partner (empty for IPOs and offerings)

type.desc: Deal type; drives the wording (Sell-side M&A, Buy-side M&A, Acquisition financing, Merger, Divestiture, IPO, Follow-on offering ...)

role.desc: The bank's role, e.g. 'Exclusive financial advisor'

description.desc: One-line deal description (tooltip; on the card with showDescription)

columns.desc: Maximum cards per row; wraps to fewer columns when a card would be narrower than minCardWidth. null = auto-fill

variant.desc: classic (framed, centred tombstone) | minimal (top rule, left-aligned)

max.desc: Show only the first N cards after sorting

highlight.desc: Company name(s); cards where either party matches get the accent2 cap, tint and monogram

facets.desc: Chip rows above the grid (channel or field names) that cross-filter; [] hides them

selectionMode.desc: dim | hide — cards outside the chip selection

monogram.desc: accent (lead party filled with the theme accent) | palette (colour hashed per company) | false (no tiles)

showDescription.desc: Show the description on the card (it is always in the tooltip)

showRole.desc: Role line at the foot of the card

format.desc: Value format (defaults to the value field format)

dateFormat.desc: Date format (defaults to the date field format, else 'mmmm yyyy')

missingValue.desc: Text for a missing deal value, e.g. 'Undisclosed' (default n.a.)

wording.desc: {'<deal type>': {lead: 'target'|'acquirer', verb, party, solo}} overrides of the built-in wording rules

tooltip.desc: Hover / focus tooltip with type, value, date, sector, region, role and description

crossFilterScope.desc: global: chips filter every dataset with the facet field (peers, precedents ...) | dataset: only this dataset

interactions: Sector / region chips cross-filter the report (non-matching cards dim)
Hover / keyboard focus lifts the card and shows a detail tooltip
Cards re-flow with a 2-D FLIP glide when global filters change
Staggered entry on reveal; static in print
